description: This file initializes the 'openpipe' module, replacing it with a deprecated proxy for backward compatibility. It imports the 'sys' module, a 'DeprecatedModuleProxy' class from 'pipecat.services', and all contents from the local 'llm' module. The file is primarily used for module-level setup and deprecation handling.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A class used to create a proxy for deprecated modules, issuing warnings or handling deprecated access.

methods.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
methods.description: Constructor for the DeprecatedModuleProxy class, used to generate a proxy object that issues deprecation warnings when accessed.
